title: Tool schema
prompt: Define an order-status custom tool with a JSON Schema input, clear description, and valid tool name.

examples.code:
tools:
  - type: custom
    name: order_status
    description: >-
      Look up an existing order by its ID.
      Use for status questions, not order changes.
      The order_id must be a nonempty string.
    input_schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        order_id:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
      required: [order_id]
      additionalProperties: false
examples.label: YAML reference excerpt

takeaway: Define an order-status custom tool with a JSON Schema input, clear description, and valid tool name.
